rows.text: when `rcx` and the qword at `[rcx]` are both non-null, replaces `edx` in sequence: -1 by the sign-extended word `+0x52` of that record, then -2 by word `+0x78`, then -3 by word `+0x7A`, then any remaining negative value by word `+0x52`; on both paths it returns `edx` when it is non-negative and 0 otherwise (`cmovns`)

takes a base of 0, or of dword `rcx+0x34` plus `ecx` as a 32-bit sum when dword `rcx+0x4` is 2; reads flags = dword `rdx+0x4` and returns 0.0 when flags bit 22 is clear; otherwise starts a pointer at `rdx+0x8`, adds 2 when flags bit 30 is set, 2 more when bit 31 is set and 0x20 more when flags AND `0x200100` equals `0x200100`, and returns the float at base + the zero-extended word at that pointer times 4

notes: 004092A0: the base is formed with 'add r8d, ecx', so it is a zero-extended 32-bit sum, not a 64-bit pointer add; stated literally. The bit-30 and bit-31 adjustments are computed before the bit-22 test but only used after it. 004092A0 is also entered from 003736D0 + 0xA8 (call); the host site 00373640 + 0x83 is a jmp. 00264CE0: the replacements cascade (a -1 replaced by word +0x52 that is itself -2 is replaced again by word +0x78).
